representation_plans.learner_operation: Trace blood filtration into the nephron and then follow tubular fluid through kidney and urinary structures in order.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: An ordered text route names cortex and medulla locations, nephron segments, ureter, bladder, and urethra without highlighting an answer.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Label transport direction at each nephron region and connect descending-versus-ascending limb properties to a medullary concentration gradient.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A text table names each segment, water permeability, salt movement, transport direction, and relative medullary concentration.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Propagate a renal transport change to blood volume, osmolarity, pH, waste removal, urine composition, storage, and elimination.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A text cause-and-effect map lists transport direction, blood consequence, urine consequence, and urinary-tract destination.
